faq.question: What time is check-in?
faq.answer: Check-in starts at 15:00 and check-out is by 12:00.

faq.question: Is breakfast available?
faq.answer: Breakfast is served from 07:00 to 10:00 in the Riverside restaurant.

faq.question: Is Wi-Fi available?
faq.answer: Guest Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel; the front desk can help if access fails.
